title: Major Glow High Shine Skin Perfecting Body Crème

specifications.Breadcrumbs: Body Lotions & Body Oils > Body Moisturizers > Bath & Body

descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Skin Barrier✓ Without Parabens✓ Good for: Dryness✓ Floral Scent✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A rich, melts-into-skin body cream for rapid moisture and high shine, made with a decadent blend of butters and oils to lock in hydration and glow.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Dullness, and Uneven Texture

Formulation: Cream

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Prickly Pear Extract: A vegan source of PHA to enhance glow by removing dead skin cells.
- Marula Oil, Mango Seed Butter, and Shea Butter: To moisturize and smooth the skin.
- Rosemary Extract and Rice Bran Oil: To provide antioxidant properties and to protect the barrier of the skin.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use daily.
-Apply from head to toe as the last step of your body care routine.
-Massage generously into dry areas, or wherever you want rich hydration and a luminous shine.
Ingredients+
-Prickly Pear Extract: A vegan source of PHA to enhance glow by removing dead skin cells.
-Marula Oil, Mango Seed Butter, and Shea Butter: To moisturize and smooth the skin.
-Rosemary Extract and Rice Bran Oil: To provide antioxidant properties and to protect the barrier of the skin.
